newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 51,800 running bales (RB) were 45 percent below the previous week and 61 percent below the 4-week average. The major increases were for Hong Kong (15,300 RB), Mexico (9,400 RB), Brazil (5,700 RB), and China (4,000 RB).
Sales of 48,800 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Japan (29,500 RB).

Exports of 168,600 RB exceeded the previous week by two-thirds, but were 8 percent less than the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 55 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 30 percent; West European, 10 percent; and the Former Soviet Union, 5 percent.
